title: Untitled (CD and Heart)
description: Mixed-media collage on white ground combines a physical compact disc and a small sculptural dome object with ink-drawn figural outlines, a heart motif, and a radiating eye symbol. Loose gestural line work depicts fragmented limbs and a face with eyes, overlaid with concentric circle tracings throughout the composition.
composition: vertical scatter with central CD anchor
keywords: ink-drawn figural outlines on white ground
